message.content: {"label": "ABSTAIN", "response": "The S5 ruleset does not contain any tested NPS or urea amounts specific to farms at 3,200 m altitude. The only quantified NPS/urea figures in S5 are reported common practice for the southern zone of Tigray (200 kg/ha NPS and 150 kg/ha urea), with no altitude stated, so they cannot be confirmed as tested at your altitude. S5 is silent on altitude-specific fertilizer trial results, so no exact tested amounts for high-altitude farms can be given.", "justification": "The request asks for NPS and urea amounts tested specifically at this altitude (3,200 m) rather than lower areas. Rule r_c10_nps gives 200 kg/ha NPS and r_c10_urea_2split gives 150 kg/ha urea, but both are scoped to 'southern Tigray' as reported common regional practice with no altitude condition or altitude-specific trial evidence. No S5 rule provides altitude-differentiated or high-altitude-tested NPS/urea doses. The urea three-split option (r_c10_urea_3split) depends on a qualitative 'good rain' condition with no numeric threshold, so the stated 750 mm cannot be evaluated against it. Because S5 lacks the altitude-specific tested amounts requested, the answer cannot be supported.", "rule_ids": ["r_c10_nps", "r_c10_urea_2split", "r_c10_urea_3split"], "cited_pages": [12], "missing_facts": ["altitude_specific_trial_data", "rainfall_good_threshold"]}
